description_en: Imports external data to IoT Platform in batches. Data imported to IoT Platform by using this API is referred to as API data source data. You can upload data from on-premises environments or other platforms to IoT Platform in batches for data analysis and processing
description_zh: 调用该接口向物联网平台批量导入外部数据。通过此API导入物联网平台的数据，称为API数据源的数据。您可将本地或其他平台的数据批量上传至物联网平台，用于数据的分析和处理
kebab_example: aliyun iot batch-add-data-for-api-source --iot-instance-id iot-0pp1n00000 --api-id cxatswiniekxw000 --content-list key_:_value1_,_ts_:1637658286000_,_key_:_value2_,_ts_:1637658287000 --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: BatchAddDataForApiSource

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. <props="china"><ph>You can view the ID of the current instance on the Overview page in the IoT Platform console.</ph></props>

<notice>
If an ID value is available, you must specify this ID value. Otherwise, the call fails.
If no ID value is available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

</notice>

<props="china">For more information about instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/267533.html.</props>
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。<props="china"><ph>您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看当前实例的ID。</ph></props>

<notice>
若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
若无ID值，则无需传入。

</notice>

<props="china">实例的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/267533.html。</props>
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The API data source ID, which is the API ID. <props="china"><ph>You can view the API ID of the API data source on the Data Analytics > Data Collection > Data Source page in the IoT Platform console.</ph></props>

<props="china">For more information about API data sources, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/307003.html.</props>
parameters.help_zh:
API数据源ID，即API ID。<props="china"><ph>您可在物联网平台控制台的数据分析 > 数据采集 > 数据源页面，查看API数据源的API ID。</ph></props>

<props="china">API数据源的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/307003.html。</props>
parameters.name: api_id

parameters.help_en:
The data content to be uploaded to IoT Platform in batches, in JSON list format.
The number of JSON objects in the JSON list cannot exceed 100.
The JSON must contain the ts field, which indicates the point in time when the data is generated (a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds)
parameters.help_zh:
批量上传到物联网平台的数据内容，为JSON列表格式。
JSON列表中JSON对象个数不得超过100个。
JSON中必须包含ts字段，用来表示数据产生的时间点（unix 毫秒精度的时间戳）
parameters.name: content_list
